definitions.explanation: An extremely low price; something being sold at a deep discount. A colloquial and emphatic term commonly seen in advertising and shopping contexts.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{激安|げきやす}だ。
{激安|げきやす}スーパーで{食材|しょくざい}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought groceries at a bargain supermarket.

examples.japanese: ネットで{激安|げきやす}の{航空券|こうくうけん}を{見|み}つけたので、すぐに{予約|よやく}した。
examples.english: I found a super cheap airline ticket online and booked it right away.

notes:
USAGE:
A colloquial compound of {激|げき} (extreme) + {安|やす}い (cheap). Commonly used as a modifier before nouns: {激安|げきやす}＋noun. Frequently seen in advertising, store signage, and online shopping.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {激安|げきやす}スーパー: bargain supermarket
- {激安|げきやす}セール: rock-bottom sale
- {激安|げきやす}{価格|かかく}: super-low price
- {激安|げきやす}ショップ: discount shop

REGISTER:
Informal and commercial. Not used in formal writing.
